DM-838 preflight: actual immediate test-grant revocation

payload.body: Actual desktop preflight evidence, not final acceptance: using first full-gate build output in isolated Temp profile/home/db-only project, the person reported hearing the native confirmation and clicking its button. Renderer then showed YOLO ACTIVE, one server approval audit entry and Revoke YOLO. Parent captured/inspected attached active PNG, clicked only Revoke YOLO, observed active indicator removed, Enable YOLO restored and a second revoked audit entry, then captured/inspected attached revoked PNG. No actual user/session grant was elevated; the grant belonged to the harmless no-tools custom CLI fixture. Native dialog image was missed because the person had already acted; no positive consent was automated. Viewport1426x864 at1.5device-scale; original PNG2139x1296. Actual surface revealed cramped vertical grant-name wrapping and date-only YOLO expiry; worker is correcting identity layout and precise expiry. These are preflight images of pre-final source and will not be presented as final corrected-build evidence.
